description:
When I try to export a large report (>10MB) from the admin dashboard, the browser hangs for 30 seconds and then shows a 504 timeout error. The report never gets exported. Smaller reports (<5MB) work fine. I'm using Chrome on macOS, and the API logs show no error — just silence. The memory usage on the API server spikes to 95% during this time.

I noticed this started happening after we deployed version 2.4.0 last Tuesday. Before that, large exports worked fine. My colleagues are having the same issue.

Error in browser console:
Uncaught TypeError: Failed to fetch

Server logs show nothing — not even a warning.

I need this fixed ASAP because our customers can't run end-of-month reporting.
